CommunityApplications.Profile:
DeployCat is the world's easiest game server manager — 1 paw installs, no claws required. 🐾
Create, configure, and manage multiple game servers from a single web interface without knocking anything off the table. Supports Minecraft (Java + Bedrock + Modded), plus Steam games like ARK, Rust, Palworld, Satisfactory, CS2, Valheim, V Rising, and 25+ more.
Free 3-day trial to sniff around. Then a paid subscription is required. Meow! for ongoing use. See https://deploycat.app for details.
For support, join our Discord or visit the project page.
